item.title: github: GitHub Copilot in VS Code, Universe releases
item.description:
GitHub says the 2026 Universe release for Copilot in VS Code adds more choice over which models you use, where agents run, and how you work with Copilot. The provided excerpt does not include the specific feature list.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.101
item.description:
Release v1.0.101 adds several CLI and MCP workflow fixes, including native structured output for dynamic workflow subagents on supported models, new assisted approval instructions, and more reliable sign-in and permission handling. It also fixes model selection, session resume/startup behavior, Windows/macOS shell command issues, and multiple provider-specific request and image-limit problems.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026
item.description:
GitHub deprecated a set of Copilot models on October 19, 2026 across most Copilot experiences, including Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions. The notice says the models are no longer available in those experiences as of that date.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | September 2026
item.description:
The September 2026 Microsoft Foundry post highlights updates across models, Routines, Tool Search, Model Router, and Insights. It presents these changes through a two-agent workflow that turns public releases into a Foundry developer changelog.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.description:

item.title: github: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna now available
item.description:

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 10
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s August 10 weekly release adds new models, portable plugins, and workflow improvements for agents. The updates are aimed at making Copilot more flexible across editors, the command line, and the Copilot app.

item.title: github: Customize the reasoning level for Copilot cloud agent
item.description:
GitHub Copilot cloud agent now lets you set the reasoning level for supported models when delegating a task. This gives you control over how much reasoning the agent uses for a request.

  • Source: GitHub
